value.text:
The University of Maribor (Univerza v Mariboru) is a public university based in Maribor, Slovenia. It is described as the country's second-largest university and comprises 17 faculties. Its academic organization includes faculties in engineering and technology, economics and business, agriculture, law, pedagogy, arts and other disciplines. Some of its faculties are based outside Maribor, reflecting an institutional presence in several Slovenian cities.

The university was established in 1975, with an opening ceremony held on 19 September of that year. Its history is connected to earlier higher-education initiatives in the region, including a theological seminary established in 1859 with the encouragement of Bishop Anton Martin Slomšek. Other faculties were formed in the late 1950s and early 1960s. These antecedents are part of its historical development, but should not be confused with the university's own establishment date.

The institution maintains a broad faculty-based teaching structure and a history of university leadership. Wikidata records approximately 13,500 students and 1,900 employees for 2020; these historical figures should not be read as current enrollment or staffing.
